question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+25 years') <= '2026-12-01'
    AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years') > '2026-12-01'
);

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) = 25
    AND (
      (CAST(STRFTIME('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) < 9)
      OR (CAST(STRFTIME('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 9 AND CAST(STRFTIME('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 25)
    )
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE p.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
  AND (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 < 2026
    OR (
      CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
      AND (
        CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) < 9
        OR (
          CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 9
          AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 25
        )
      )
    )
  )
  AND NOT (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
    AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 9
    AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND o.date < '2026-09-25'
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-05-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00' 
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    -- Customer is exactly 25 years old at the time of the order
    -- Calculate age by checking if the 25th birthday has passed but 26th hasn't
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) = 25
    AND (
      CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) > CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      OR (
        CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) = CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        AND CAST(strftime('%d', o.date) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      )
    )
    AND (
      CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) < CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      OR (
        CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) = CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        AND CAST(strftime('%d', o.date) AS INTEGER) < CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      )
    )
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of product d only, for orders placed from 2026-09-01 00:00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id = 'd'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 
    (CASE 
      WHEN CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) > CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER) 
      OR (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER) 
          AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) > CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 9, 2) AS INTEGER))
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END)
  ) = 25;
